texts_per_file.0010.png: On a lazy weekend afternoon bathed in sunshine, golden rays slanted into the living room of little Tangtang's home. Tangtang stood on tiptoes, leaning over the kitchen counter, kneading a ball of white dough with all his might. His color-changing T-shirt glowed with a warm golden hue, a clear sign he was thoroughly enjoying kneading the dough.
texts_per_file.0020.png: Tangtang wore cargo shorts with zippered pockets—his left pocket bulged with rainbow-colored plasticine, and a hand-drawn 'Family Combat Training Rules Chart' peeked out of his right. The Star Loom Bracelet on his wrist rested quietly against his skin, like a calm little star. He muttered softly 'Hurry up and rise, dough!'
texts_per_file.0030.png: Suddenly, the Star Loom Bracelet on his wrist chimed 'Ding——' and a pale golden glow spread instantly! The old wall clock in the living room let out a soft 'click', and its door creaked open slowly. Star Loom, dressed in a silver-white robe, leaped lightly out of the gap, his lapis lazuli eyes shimmering with a gentle blue light.
texts_per_file.0040.png: Star Loom's voice was like wind chimes 'A secret door has opened at home today! Want to see who can turn cake-making into a boxing match and stir laughter into the cream.' With a flick of his fingertip, the non-slip kitchen mat suddenly rolled up, its edges folding into soft steps like a freshly baked soufflé.
texts_per_file.0050.png: Meanwhile in the kitchen, Tom wore a bright orange sports vest and bounced around the counter in inflatable spring shoes, 'thump-thump'. A hiccuping sandbag was clipped to his waist, and he tiptoed carefully, fearing the spring shoes would launch him too hard and make him fall.
texts_per_file.0060.png: Jerry's voice came from the top of the cabinet 'Silly Tom, practicing boxing in secret again!' He was draped in an old curtain cloak, a rubber band wrapped around his tail, and a peppermint candy whistle glowed green in his ear, his eyes brimming with mischief.
texts_per_file.0070.png: Tom glared defiantly at Jerry, and the spring shoes under his feet suddenly launched him—'Whoosh!' he jumped up, but lost control of his direction, and his head 'thud' hit the cabinet door. The sandbag at his waist let out a big 'Hic——' and puffed out fine sand, tickling him so much he wriggled uncontrollably.
texts_per_file.0080.png: Tuffy stood on tiptoes, reaching furtively for the sugar jar on the counter, a round jelly water bottle slung over his back. The water bottle bubbled with transparent bubbles every now and then, the gummy eyes on the tip of the straw rolled black and shiny, and blueberry soda dripped on the floor, forming tiny bubbles.
texts_per_file.0090.png: Spike stood tall and straight in front of the stove, wearing a star-patterned apron and a paper chef's hat askew on his head. He boomed loudly 'No fooling around! Baking is about rules!' He adjusted his lopsided hat as he spoke.
texts_per_file.0100.png: Tyke followed Spike, dressed in a 'Boxing Bear' onesie with squishy sponge boxing gloves. The zipper at his back 'pfft-pfft' deflated, pushing him waddling along. He shouted 'Daddy, wait for me! I want to practice boxing, and make cake too!'
texts_per_file.0110.png: 'Everyone come quick, we're leaving!' Tangtang waved the dough in his hand, his T-shirt still glowing golden. Tom rubbed his head, and his spring shoes bounced gently; Jerry leaped down from the cabinet, the bells on his cloak jangling; Tuffy hurried to catch up.
texts_per_file.0120.png: Spike took Tyke's hand and stepped carefully onto the bouncing cloud ladder. 'Whoosh——' His feet sank softly, as if stepping on a freshly baked soufflé, with a faint aroma of wheat. The group held hands and hopped onto the ladder.
texts_per_file.0130.png: The ladder rose higher and higher, passing through a layer of white mist scented with cinnamon. The scene before them suddenly opened up—this was no longer the kitchen, but Star Loom's Training House! The walls were flowing chocolate sauce, and chocolate beans dotted the floor.
texts_per_file.0140.png: Inside the training house, the refrigerator had transformed into a towering ice giant, its eyes two round peppermint candies, and a smile curved on its lips. The oven leaned against the wall, humming a tune, with a marshmallow hanging from its doorknob.
texts_per_file.0150.png: On the stove stood a ring piled high with marshmallows, edged with colorful candy floss. Floating in the air were smiling sandbags with dark chocolate bean eyes that shouted 'Fight! Fight!' when touched.
texts_per_file.0160.png: In the corner, a silver mixer spun wildly, flinging cream that condensed into tiny stars in the air, slowly falling to become butter cookies. A group of kitchen sprites made of flour, wearing measuring cup hats, sprayed flour to welcome everyone.
texts_per_file.0170.png: 'Welcome to Star Loom's Training House!' The lead sprite shook his hat 'Today's mission, make snacks, practice boxing, and laugh until the cream flies!' Tangtang's T-shirt glowed even brighter with excitement.
texts_per_file.0180.png: Spike tightened his apron and pulled out a crumpled 'Family Baking License', 'By the rules, before making snacks, wash your hands, measure ingredients, and finally—no sneaking sugar!' As soon as he finished speaking, there was a 'pop' sound.
texts_per_file.0190.png: It was Tuffy, who couldn't resist twisting open his jelly water bottle—blueberry soda burst out in a string of big bubbles. The bubbles floated in the air for a moment, then 'pop' burst open, jumping out three mini Tuffys! They scampered around the sugar jar chattering.
texts_per_file.0200.png: 'Naughty rascals, stop right now!' Spike reached out to grab them, but slipped, and his chef's hat fell off, landing squarely on Tyke's head. Tyke wore the oversized hat, unable to see the way, and the zipper at his back deflated 'pfft-pfft' uncontrollably.
texts_per_file.0210.png: Seeing this, Jerry pulled the peppermint candy whistle from his ear and blew it, the bells on his cloak jingling. He stretched the rubber band on his tail, 'whoosh' catapulted himself to the chandelier, hung upside down, picked up a piece of rainbow plasticine, and threw it at Tom.
texts_per_file.0220.png: Tom thought it was real cheese, jumped 'whoosh' in his spring shoes, but the soles were too slippery—he missed, and plunged headfirst into a nearby flour sack. 'A——choo!' He sneezed loudly, covered head to toe in flour like a 'flour cat'.
texts_per_file.0230.png: Strangely enough, the sneeze made no sound! It turned out that when he jumped, he had accidentally swallowed the 'silencing peppermint candy' Jerry had hidden in the fake cheese, rendering him temporarily mute. Tom opened his mouth wide but no sound came out, looking utterly confused.
texts_per_file.0240.png: Tyke finally wriggled out from under the chef's hat, saw Tom's state, put on his sponge boxing gloves and shouted, 'KO! KO!' He waved his gloves wildly, the zipper at his back deflating loudly, knocking over the cream whirlpool.
texts_per_file.0250.png: Cream splashed out 'crash', condensing into a large cream cloud in the air that slowly drifted toward everyone. Tangtang quickly pulled out the 'Family Combat Training Rules Chart' and held it high, 'Rule number one, take three deep breaths before fooling around!'
texts_per_file.0260.png: Tangtang led the way in taking deep breaths—inhale——exhale——inhale——exhale——inhale——exhale! To the rhythm of his breathing, the floor of the training house vibrated slightly, and the kitchen sprites formed a circle, singing in unison, 'Breathe in sunshine, breathe out worries!'
texts_per_file.0270.png: Tom patted the flour off his face, revealing two round eyes, and scratched his head embarrassedly. The sandbag at his waist let out a 'Hic——' as if apologizing. Jerry slid down from the chandelier and handed him a piece of rainbow gummy candy.
texts_per_file.0280.png: Tom took the gummy candy and popped it into his mouth, wagging his tail at Jerry. Though he still couldn't speak, his eyes were full of forgiveness. Tangtang's T-shirt slowly turned a gentle lake blue, and he smiled, 'Let's make a Courage Cake together!'
texts_per_file.0290.png: Everyone followed Spike to the counter. Spike pulled out measuring spoons, '3 spoons of flour, 2 spoons of sugar, 1 egg, and we need to add yeast sprites—they'll help the dough grow.' He poured out a few yellow granules.
texts_per_file.0300.png: Tangtang stared curiously at the yeast, and the Star Loom Bracelet chimed 'ding', popping up small characters, 'Yeast produces carbon dioxide through respiration, making the dough ferment and expand.' The sprites gathered around the yeast and shouted, 'Blow bubbles!'
texts_per_file.0310.png: Next, they came to the Emotion Seasoning Station. The shelf was lined with colorful bottles, 'Brave Red', 'Calm Blue', 'Happy Yellow', 'Gentle Pink'. Star Loom said, 'Making snacks requires the right mood—when the mood is right, the cake will be sweet.'
texts_per_file.0320.png: Tangtang picked up the 'Calm Blue' bottle and dripped 3 drops into the batter. The batter immediately rippled with a faint lake blue hue, emitting a cool peppermint aroma. Tangtang's T-shirt turned the same color as the batter.
texts_per_file.0330.png: Spike wanted to make the cake more 'courageous', so he picked up the 'Brave Red' bottle—but his hand trembled, and he poured 5 extra drops! The batter 'boom' burst into tiny flames, startling everyone back.
texts_per_file.0340.png: Spike hastily grabbed the pot lid to cover it, but the lid 'bang' popped open, flying out and hitting the chandelier. The chandelier swayed, showering golden light that formed a tiny shadow theater on the wall.
texts_per_file.0350.png: In the shadows on the wall, Tom and Jerry were cooperating to stack things high. Tom held up a pot, Jerry put eggs into it, their teamwork seamless—they even bumped fists and smiled happily.
texts_per_file.0360.png: Tom and Jerry in reality locked eyes, then suddenly pounced on the counter at the same time, saying in unison, 'We're a team this time!' Though Tom couldn't speak, Jerry understood immediately and nodded with a smile.
texts_per_file.0370.png: They worked together in perfect harmony! Tom jumped up precisely in his spring shoes, catching the eggs Jerry tossed from above, and carefully placed them into the bowl, fearing they would crack.
texts_per_file.0380.png: Jerry, meanwhile, used the rubber band on his tail to pull the flour sack into a tiny catapult—'whoosh'—and accurately sprinkled powdered sugar into the bowl. The bells on his cloak jingled 'ding-ling-ding-ling', as if cheering them on.
texts_per_file.0390.png: Tyke volunteered to be the timer, pulling a small timer from Spike's apron pocket and shouting '90 seconds left!' every minute.
texts_per_file.0400.png: But he spoke so fast he tongue-tied himself, blurting out 'Le-le-le... seconds seconds seconds!' This made Tuffy laugh until he doubled over, his jelly water bottle bubbling 'gurgle-gurgle' and spraying a rainbow bubble rain.
texts_per_file.0410.png: When the bubbles landed on the oven, it immediately switched songs, playing a rock version of 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star'. The temperature adjusted automatically to 'Perfect Fluffiness Mode', and the marshmallow on the oven doorknob turned even softer.
texts_per_file.0420.png: Star Loom smiled and said, 'Dough warmed by sunshine will be fluffier, because light warms objects and makes the yeast sprites more active.' He pointed a finger, and a beam of sunlight fell on the batter.
texts_per_file.0430.png: Tuffy thought it was fun, poured a little blueberry soda from his jelly water bottle into the batter. When the soda hit the batter, it immediately bubbled up wildly, and the batter swelled 'pfft-pfft'.
texts_per_file.0440.png: Tom was so startled he jumped back, his spring shoes 'thump-thump'—he almost crashed into the kitchen sprites. Jerry quickly blew his peppermint candy whistle, and the whistle sound turned blue, signaling everyone to calm down.
texts_per_file.0450.png: Jerry wrapped a rubber band around the batter bowl to keep it from overflowing. 'The cake batter is ready!' Spike carefully lifted the bowl, put it into the oven, and closed the oven door.
texts_per_file.0460.png: The oven chimed 'ding!', and the screen displayed 'Remaining time, 15 minutes'. Tyke cheered and jumped up, the zipper at his back deflating 'pfft-pfft', waving his sponge boxing gloves, 'Next, practice boxing! To the Echo Boxing Glove Corridor!'
texts_per_file.0470.png: Everyone followed Tyke to the Echo Boxing Glove Corridor. The walls here were made of colorful pots and pans, red woks, blue soup pots, silver frying pans, plus small spoons and forks.
texts_per_file.0480.png: Rows of colorful boxing gloves hung in the corridor, each with a smiling face that shouted 'Go for it!' when touched. Star Loom explained, 'When you punch, the wall punches back; when you jump, the wall jumps too.'
texts_per_file.0490.png: Star Loom revealed a secret, 'Only perfectly synchronized movements trigger the Dual Starlight. Also, sound travels at different speeds through different materials—you can try tapping different pots and pans.'
texts_per_file.0500.png: Tangtang was the first to pick up a red boxing glove, tapping the iron pot beside him—'Dong——' a deep, loud sound; then tapping the silver frying pan—'Ding——' a crisp, pleasant sound.
texts_per_file.0510.png: Tom also picked up a glove, tapping the blue soup pot—'Boom——' a muffled sound. The sandbag at his waist let out a 'Hic——' as if echoing him.
texts_per_file.0520.png: Jerry jumped onto the wall, wrapped a rubber band around a spoon with his tail, flicked it gently—the spoon hit a fork, making a 'ding-ling' sound, thin and small, unlike any before.
texts_per_file.0530.png: Tangtang pulled out the 'Family Combat Training Rules Chart', 'Let's have a family combat training session! But not fighting—cooperative challenges!' He announced the rules, 'Pair up, and complete three synchronized actions in the corridor—high-five, spin around, hug.'
texts_per_file.0540.png: 'As long as you cooperate in perfect harmony, you'll trigger starlight—the brightest starlight wins!' Everyone nodded and began grouping up. The first pair was Spike and Tyke.
texts_per_file.0550.png: Spike squatted down, and Tyke, in his onesie, waddled up and jumped onto his dad's shoulders, his sponge gloves resting gently on Spike's head. Father and son locked eyes, raised their hands together, and high-fived with a 'pop'.
texts_per_file.0560.png: Then they spun around in sync, and finally Spike hugged Tyke gently, and Tyke kissed his dad on the cheek. 'Wow!' As they finished the actions, the corridor walls suddenly lit up with pink light, the light patterns spreading like hearts.
texts_per_file.0570.png: The second pair was Tuffy and the lead kitchen sprite. Tuffy, with his jelly water bottle on his back, jumped onto a floating sandbag with the sprite. The sandbag wobbled, and Tuffy almost fell— the sprite quickly steadied him.
texts_per_file.0580.png: They took a deep breath, high-fived, spun around, and hugged in perfect sync. The sprite hugged Tuffy and sprayed a cloud of flour—the walls immediately flashed with silvery snowflake light, which fell to the ground and turned into tiny flour cookies.
texts_per_file.0590.png: Tangtang's T-shirt turned lake blue, and he said earnestly, 'Next up, Tom and Jerry!' Tom and Jerry walked to the middle of the corridor. Tom was a little nervous, his spring shoes hissing and leaking air, and his sandbag let out a hiccup too.
texts_per_file.0600.png: Jerry patted him on the shoulder and blew his peppermint candy whistle, the sound turning green, 'Don't be afraid—pretend we're chasing the same piece of cheese—oh no, the same star!' Tom nodded and took a deep breath.
texts_per_file.0610.png: They raised their hands at the same time, high-fiving gently with a 'pop'—the movement was precise and synchronized; then they spun around together, the bells on Jerry's cloak jingling, and Tom's spring shoes bouncing lightly.
texts_per_file.0620.png: Finally, Tom bent down, Jerry jumped into his arms, and Tom hugged Jerry gently with his paws. 'Boom!' At that moment, the corridor walls suddenly erupted in golden fireworks, the light bright and warm.
texts_per_file.0630.png: The entire Star Loom Training House shook, and a singing 'Cooperation Medal' descended from the ceiling, engraved with Tom and Jerry's likenesses. It landed gently around their necks, jangling 'ding-ding-dang-dang'.
texts_per_file.0640.png: Just then, the oven suddenly chimed 'Ding!'—the cake was done! Everyone hurried to the oven. Spike carefully opened the oven door, and a rich aroma wafted out.
texts_per_file.0650.png: But when they saw the cake, everyone froze—the surface of the cake had dark spots like sunspots, looking dull and unappealing. Star Loom said softly, 'The cake absorbed too much impetuous energy.'
texts_per_file.0660.png: Star Loom added, 'It needs Happy Cooling—only enough laughter can remove the dark spots.' Tangtang had a bright idea, holding up the rules chart, 'Then let's laugh together, and cool the cake with our laughter!'
texts_per_file.0670.png: Everyone sprang into action! Tyke, in his 'Boxing Bear' onesie, performed the 'Deflating Boxing Step'—waving his fists and spinning around, the zipper at his back deflating 'pfft-pfft' like a clown performing.
texts_per_file.0680.png: Tuffy, with his jelly water bottle, ran all over the training house, blowing bubbles and hopping in circles. The mini Tuffys joined in the mischief, covered in flour from head to toe. Spike pretended to be choked by flour and deliberately sneezed loudly.
texts_per_file.0690.png: Tom and Jerry reenacted their classic chase—but this time, it wasn't a fight. They ran circles around the cake, laughing as they went. Tom's spring shoes 'thump-thumped', Jerry's bells 'ding-linged', their coordination perfect.
texts_per_file.0700.png: As Tom ran, his palms got hot, so he rubbed his paws together—and white smoke billowed out! Star Loom smiled and said, 'This is friction generating heat—rubbing two hands together produces heat.'
texts_per_file.0710.png: Everyone's laughter grew louder and louder, turning into colorful cool breezes that swept over the cake. The dark spots on the cake slowly melted into golden sugar frosting stars, and the cake itself glowed with an enticing sheen.
texts_per_file.0720.png: Spike picked up a cake knife, carefully cut a piece, and handed it to Tangtang, 'This is the Courage and Cooperation Cake—every bite is filled with everyone's care.' Tangtang took the cake, and his T-shirt turned a warm orange-red.
texts_per_file.0730.png: Tangtang took a bite—the cake melted in his mouth, sweet with a hint of cool peppermint. He closed his eyes, as if seeing everyone's hard work together, his heart warm and full.
texts_per_file.0740.png: Tom and Jerry also got pieces of cake. They locked eyes, and at the same time, each picked out the biggest chocolate bean and gave it to the other. Though Tom still couldn't speak, his eyes were full of joy.
texts_per_file.0750.png: Tuffy poured blueberry soda from his jelly water bottle onto the cake—the soda hit the cake, and tiny rainbow bubbles popped up again. Tyke got cream all over his face and wiped it on Spike's apron.
texts_per_file.0760.png: Star Loom watched everyone and smiled, 'Today's training is over. You've learned to cooperate, and to overcome difficulties with laughter. That's the greatest superpower.'
texts_per_file.0770.png: As Star Loom finished speaking, the walls of the training house began to turn transparent, and the chocolate sauce walls slowly transformed back into kitchen tiles. Everyone found themselves sitting on the kitchen floor, empty plates in their hands.
texts_per_file.0780.png: Tom patted his stomach and burped—not the sandbag's hiccup, but his own! 'Hic——That was delicious!' He was delighted to find he could speak again. Jerry laughed and patted him on the back.
texts_per_file.0790.png: Tangtang looked at the Star Loom Bracelet on his wrist—it had turned back into an ordinary bracelet, no longer glowing. But he knew everything that had just happened was real. Looking at his friends beside him, his heart was filled with gratitude.
texts_per_file.0800.png: The sunshine outside the window was still warm, and the kitchen was filled with the lingering aroma of cake. Everyone squeezed onto the sofa, tired but happy. Tangtang closed his eyes and had a sweet dream, filled with stars and laughter.
